fixes.what: Add `loading="lazy"` to `` inside `.tree__trunk`, `.tree__sprig`, and `.ground-art` (keep eager loading on `.tree__bark` only if it enters Screen 1).
fixes.why: Prevents the full-tree image (rows 0–3714) from competing with the preloaded canopy slices (`canopy-L0` to `L3`) for initial network bandwidth on Screen 1.

fixes.what: Inside `measureMorph()`, wrap `var r = navImg.getBoundingClientRect();` by temporarily disabling CSS transitions or reading `offsetLeft`/`offsetTop` relative to `.site-header__inner` instead of `getBoundingClientRect()`.
fixes.why: `getBoundingClientRect()` reads live transform values, which could theoretically capture mid-transition geometry if a layout refresh happens during a CSS transition.

fixes.what: Add `will-change: transform` to `html.canopy-motion .tree__sprig` only while intersecting, or let GSAP handle 3D promotion automatically (`force3D: true`).
fixes.why: Ensures consistent GPU layer promotion behaviour across desktop browsers during continuous yoyo rotation tweens.
